name: Native VR (OpenXR / SteamVR)
summary: Games with first-party VR support via OpenXR or SteamVR. True stereo rendering with separate left/right eye cameras at native headset resolution. Includes full headtracking and (typically) motion controller support.
compatibility_notes: Requires a VR headset. OpenXR is the modern standard; SteamVR is the most widely supported runtime. Native VR games have the best performance and quality — no injection or workaround required.
